description: Unit test class for UserUnlockedReceiver, testing its behavior when receiving different intents and creating intent filters.

classes.name: UserUnlockedReceiverTest
classes.description: Test class for UserUnlockedReceiver, verifying intent handling and filter creation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, setting up application context, mock unlock consumer, and receiver instance.

methods.name: testDoesNotRunOnNullIntent
methods.description: Verifies that receiver does not act when given a null intent.

methods.name: testDoesNotRunOnWrongAction
methods.description: Verifies that receiver does not act on intents with actions other than user unlocked.

methods.name: testRunsOnUserUnlocked
methods.description: Verifies that receiver correctly responds to ACTION_USER_UNLOCKED intent.

methods.name: testCreatesValidIntentFilter
methods.description: Checks that the intent filter created by UserUnlockedReceiver is valid and contains the correct action.
